paper.title: Promoter methylation in key DNA damage response genes shows a positive correlation with cumulative dose in chronically low-dose radiation-exposed individuals
paper.affiliation_corresponding: Low Level Radiation Research Section, Radiation Biology and Health Sciences Division, Bio-Sciences Group, Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC); Homi Bhabha National Institute

contents: Supplementary Table 1: MS-HRM primer sequences and sources for LINE-1 + 16 DDR genes
Supplementary Table 2: MS-HRM cycling conditions (annealing temp, acquisition range, MgCl2 conc.)

data_accessions.notes: Pilot MS-HRM study (n=26); no per-sample raw or processed data deposited per EuropePMC/OpenAlex/Unpaywall/figshare. Only primer sequences + cycling conditions are public.

cohort.site: Kerala HLNRA (high-level natural radiation areas), India

methods_summary.stat_models: between-group hypermethylation tests + correlation of methylation vs cumulative mSv (RAD23B strongest)

key_results.global_LINE1: no significant difference across exposure groups
key_results.expression_correlation: high inter-individual variation; no dose-dependent change or methylation-expression correlation
